name: RV Trip Planner
tagline: Holds a multi-day RV route and checks overnight spots in real time
description: Built around full-time RV travel, where the route is never really finished. The whole trip is held as a working plan in the chat, overnight availability at the networks you belong to is checked while you travel, and each reservation is lined up for your own click. A booking is never completed without you.
author: Cmillet77
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
